name: Be Queen Bee
description:
About This Game

The flower fields have been taken over by enemies, and your bee colony is starving.

'Be Queen Bee' is an action-strategy game where you take on the role of the Queen Bee, commanding your swarm with pheromone signals to survive against hostile forces.

Lead your bees to fend off ruthless predators and read the ever-changing flow of battle in real-time to strategize your victory.

Now, it’s time to give orders to your swarm.

Seize the flower fields and fight to secure your colony’s survival through strength and strategy.

Intuitive Pheromone Command : Your Will is Law

The pheromones you release are absolute commands. Gather your swarm where your mouse points and strike enemies in coordinated attacks to turn the tide of battle. Experience the thrill of reversing the battlefield with a single pheromone mark.

Tactical Positioning : Victory from the Heart of the Frontline.

Command isn’t done from the rear—it happens in the thick of battle. Disperse your bees or infiltrate enemy blind spots depending on the threat type. Your positioning and formation management will determine both survival and victory.

Survival : Keep Moving and Harvest Honey.

Collect honey from flower fields captured from predators. Resources are limited; once the honey runs out, your bees must fly again to survive. Stopping even briefly invites starvation.

Growth : Evolve Your Bees with Collected Honey.

Upgrade your bees’ carapaces and sharpen their stingers to expand your swarm. Growth is not a choice—it’s a necessity for survival.

Key Features

  • Real-time Swarm Command : Control your bees with a single pheromone signal as if they were an extension of your own body.

  • Strategic Survival : Blindly rushing is a death sentence. Maintain formations and dominate the battlefield against your enemies.

  • Evolution and Expansion : Gather honey to strengthen your swarm and carve out new nesting grounds in predator-controlled forests.

short_desc: "Be Queen Bee" is an action-strategy game where you become the Queen Bee and command your swarm with pheromones. Defeat predators, seize flower fields to escape hunger, evolve your swarm with honey, and strategize in real time to secure victory.
